rule: Endoscope station poses on the standard specimen (E5, Opus, 2026-10-07). Key "t.<id>.<side>" (a midline station: ".M", posed from the right nostril). pose: scope.js fields (fulcrum lm.naris.<side>). Every pose is free under scope.js shaftClearance with the 4 mm shaft and the E3b midline rule, its tip lies in airway air (not in mucosa: this specimen is not decongested, and a tip in tissue sees a uniform field), and its target is within the 35 degree half field. target: a landmark, or a label whose voxel centroid is the point, or an explicit RAS point "at" (between: the midpoint of two landmarks). measured: what a cone of rays (161, over the 70 degree field) hits first through the labelled air, in percent of the image; "tissue" is unlabelled soft tissue with no labelled wall within 8 mm behind it. The left poses are the right ones mirrored: the same side-relative depth, yaw and pitch, roll -> 360 - roll. WP P3 (2026-10): `byState` holds poses for dissected states, key = a state of ssb/states/index.json, then "t.<id>.<side>" as above; each is held to this rule on THAT state's volume (the base with its patch applied), and its tip lies in an airway label of the state (s.nasal-cavity, s.nasopharynx, a sinus, an ethmoid cell, the frontal recess; not s.nasal-vestibule). `shaft`: "2.7" when the pose is free only for the 2.7 mm telescope (the olfactory cleft, the inferior meatus); absent = 4 mm. A station posed through the contralateral nostril is keyed by its target's side. Solved by tools/ssb-pipeline/uw/stations.py (prototype pose first, then a search), left = right mirrored and verified on the mirrored state.
